This separate complete example makes those two results visible:
```swift
let distanceText = String(12)
print(distanceText)
print(distanceText.contains("2"))
```
The output is 12, then true. String receives the integer 12 and creates the text "12". contains receives the text to find and returns a Bool: true when it occurs, false otherwise. It does not change distanceText. The quotes around "2" make the search input text, not a number.
